Tell them you heard Tripwire stepped in and that stopping was exactly the right thing to do. Remind them a real company will always let them take their time. Ask if they would like to look at it together.

Tell them you are not worried about blame, you just want to help. Suggest calling the real bank or company together, using a number from a card or a statement. Ask them not to send money or install anything until you have spoken.
